🔥U Card consumption volume surged 28× year-over-year, while stablecoin yield assets grew 10×.

With real data, Bitget Wallet  proves that the genuine demand for payments + wealth management is exploding. The wallet is becoming users’ #1 daily entry point for payments, transfers, and finance.

In this episode of Actually You Know, host @kaylawangnow heads to Consensus Hong Kong 2026 for a Quick-Fire Interview with Will Wu @SrWillWill , APAC Head of @BitgetWallet.

From offline payments in Southeast Asia (paying for street fruit in Vietnam or a haircut in the Philippines) to cross-border remittances in Latin America, and the Gas Free / GetGas feature that removes multi-chain friction for users.  

Bitget Wallet is turning Everyday Finance into a true All-in-One Wallet: trading, payments, and wealth management — all in one self-custodial wallet. No more switching between multiple apps.
